## Install

Run this in a terminal (on a Steam Deck, switch to Desktop Mode and open Konsole):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/cgrd/whisker/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

No terminal? Download `Install-Whisker.desktop` below and double-click it. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.

Whisker downloads the NVIDIA Parakeet speech model on first use. The model is licensed separately by NVIDIA under the [NVIDIA Open Model License](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/agreements/enterprise-software/nvidia-open-model-license/).
